title: Abyssals v0.90.62 — Triskit Branches
notes: Five new Triskit evolutions join Marasen’s Evolution Atelier. Find Winter Key, Winkbell, Quarry Husk, Nightstill Vial and Reverie Fan. The update adds five new primary abilities, a one-use Quarry Spill entry hazard and item-only evolution for all eight Triskit forms at any level. Existing saves carry forward. Validation now checks the expanded Triskit learnsets and the complete live evolution-item catalogue, including all five new items.
